svg.title: Per-build state and ClangTidyContext
svg.desc: Stack-local tidy state becomes per-build listener state. Context outlives its checks and MatchFinder; matching is invoked directly after parsing. Options move into ClangTidyContext; member order preserves dependent lifetimes. Preamble listeners remain inactive. No deferred-consumer state is introduced.
svg.text: Stack-local tidy state becomes per-build listener state. Context outlives its checks and MatchFinder; matching is invoked directly after
// The lifetime of DiagnosticOptions is managed by \c Clang.
// The lifetime of DiagnosticOptions is managed by \c Clang.
// Destruction order matters: Finder and checks refer to Context.
Options move into ClangTidyContext; member order preserves dependent lifetimes.
Preamble listeners remain inactive. No deferred-consumer state is introduced.
